select vk.user_id, vk.user_name, vk.mobile as userMobile, uiv.is_superior, inviterOne.user_name as oneInviter, inviterTwo.user_name as twoInviter, vk.tg_num as totalTgUserNum, vk.total_share_commission as totalShareCommission, vk.withdrawn_commission + vk.pending_withdrawn_commission as totalCommission, vk.withdrawn_commission as withdrawnCommission, vk.pending_withdrawn_commission as pendingWithdrawnCommission, vk.create_time from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_vk vk left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_inviter uiv on vk.user_id = uiv.user_id left join (select user_mobile, user_id, user_name, user_nickname from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info) inviterOne on inviterOne.user_id = uiv.one_inviter left join (select user_mobile, user_id, user_name, user_nickname from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info) inviterTwo on inviterTwo.user_id = uiv.two_inviter
and vk.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userName},'%')
and vk.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.mobile},'%')
and (inviterOne.user_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.inviterMobile},'%') or inviterOne.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.inviterMobile},'%') or inviterOne.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.inviterMobile},'%') or inviterTwo.user_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.inviterMobile},'%') or inviterTwo.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.inviterMobile},'%') or inviterTwo.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.inviterMobile},'%'))
order by vk.create_time desc
select count(1) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base where buyer_user_id = #{userId} and is_gift_order = 1

select ob.order_id, ob.is_gift_order, ui.user_id, ui.user_name, ui.user_mobile from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob left join ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info ui on ob.buyer_user_id = ui.user_id where (ob.order_id = #{orderId} or ob.payment_number = #{orderId})

select sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, 1, 0)) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc where oc.buy_user_id = #{userId} and oc.order_status != 5

select sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{userId}, oc.fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId}, oc.one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, oc.two_tg_commission, 0)) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc where oc.buy_user_id = #{userId} and oc.order_status = 3

select sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{userId}, oc.fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId}, oc.one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, oc.two_tg_commission, 0)) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc where (oc.share_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}) and oc.order_status = 3 and oc.fx_settlement_status = 1 and DATE(STR_TO_DATE(oc.fx_settlement_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = DATE(STR_TO_DATE(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'))

select sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{userId}, oc.fx_commission - oc.return_fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId}, oc.one_tg_commission - oc.return_one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, oc.two_tg_commission - oc.return_two_tg_commission, 0)) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob on ob.order_id = oc.order_id where (oc.share_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}) and oc.order_status in (1,2,4,6) and oc.fx_settlement_status = 0 and DATE(STR_TO_DATE(ob.order_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d')) = DATE(STR_TO_DATE(now(), '%Y-%m-%d'))

select sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{userId}, oc.fx_commission - oc.return_fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId}, oc.one_tg_commission - oc.return_one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, oc.two_tg_commission - oc.return_two_tg_commission, 0)) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc left join ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base ob on ob.order_id = oc.order_id where (oc.share_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}) and oc.order_status in (1,2,4,6) and oc.fx_settlement_status = 0

select count(DISTINCT oc.order_id) as fxOrderNum, sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{inviterUserId}, oc.fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{inviterUserId}, oc.one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{inviterUserId}, oc.two_tg_commission, 0)) as fxMoney from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc where (oc.share_user_id = #{inviterUserId} or oc.tg_one_user_id = #{inviterUserId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{inviterUserId}) and oc.order_status != 5 and oc.buy_user_id = #{userId} group by oc.buy_user_id

select sum(IF(oc.share_user_id = #{userId}, oc.fx_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId}, oc.one_tg_commission, 0) + IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, oc.two_tg_commission, 0)) from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc where (oc.share_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}) and oc.order_status = 6 and oc.fx_settlement_status = 0

select count(distinct oc.order_id) as totalSettlementOrderNum, sum(IF(oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId}, oc.one_tg_commission, 0)) as totalOneTgCommission, sum(IF(oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}, oc.two_tg_commission, 0)) as totalTwoTgCommission from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_commission oc where (oc.tg_one_user_id = #{userId} or oc.tg_two_user_id = #{userId}) and oc.order_status = 3 and oc.fx_settlement_status = 1

SELECT uv.id, uv.user_id, uv.user_name, uv.real_name, uv.mobile, uv.tg_num, uv.share_num, uv.source, uv.total_tg_commission, uv.total_share_commission, uv.create_time, uv.withdrawn_commission, ubc.bind_openid as openId, uv.pending_withdrawn_commission FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_vk uv LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_bind_connect ubc ON uv.user_id = ubc.user_id WHERE uv.user_id = #{userId} order by ubc.bind_openid DESC limit 1
